name: Code Review
description: Systematic code review for bugs, security issues, and maintainability problems.
short_description: Find real defects with evidence, ordered by severity.
store_description: A structured code review workflow that inspects correctness, security, error handling, maintainability, and tests. Every finding is backed by a quoted excerpt and a concrete fix recommendation. Use this skill when the user asks you to review a patch, audit a file, or assess a change before merging.

examples.context: User has just attached a .py file and asked to review it.
examples.expected_outcome: Agent produces findings grouped by severity with file:line references.

examples.context: Every run of the agent should perform a review of produced files.
examples.expected_outcome: Agent always loads the code_review instructions before reasoning.
